why: Founder: 'Let's rescore all weekly comp leagues.' Week 4 of the weekly contest leagues (high, golf, bullseye) re-stamped under v0.701.x: a player hurt in his game (the injury report dated to his kickoff) no longer takes the dart's no-show penalty, and the plays now score on the worker. Contest leagues only (--contest-only); classic leagues keep their stored finals. Prints every matchup it moves.
